Lower Text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [Shaman] trait or with [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign], other than [Sea Animal], in any of its traits and 1 card with the [TS] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
